onChange.script:
if self.custom.key!=None:
		uuid=self.custom.key
		path='Exchange/ArchitectureBuilder/Frames/EmbeddedViews/PipeConfig'
		params={'uuid':uuid}
		title='Connection Configuration'
		system.perspective.sendMessage('openPopup', {'uuid':uuid, 'path':path,'params':params,'title':title},scope='session')
		self.custom.key=None
